ingredients: 2 lbs. flour.  1 lb. best butter.  1/2 lb. powdered sugar.  Chop the flour and butter together, having made the butter quite soft by setting it near the fire. Knead in the sugar, roll into a sheet half an inch thick, and cut in shapes with a cake-cutter. Bake upon buttered paper in a shallow tin until crisp and of a delicate yellowish brown.
